summary: v4 resolves v3's one open finding (step 4's local-mapping instruction now names a concrete mechanism - clean.py's own --map flag - instead of an unactionable 'apply the table by hand') and goes further: canonical-schema mapping is now explicitly opt-in (only done when the user asks for it, not implied as a default part of cleaning), and doing it locally is a single deterministic script invocation rather than free-form manual header rewriting, with the external service demoted to an explicit-request-only path. No findings remain; the two structural-check candidates (Bash declared-but-unreferenced, missing optional sections) are the same pre-existing false positive/info-level items dismissed in every prior version.
